name: regi
description: See and operate the computers Regi reaches through JetKVM, PiKVM and VNC.
long_description: Lets Claude list your saved hosts, open sessions as ordinary Regi windows, take screenshots, use power controls, and run short scripts that read the screen with on-device OCR, type, click and wait, so a whole sequence of steps is one call. While a script runs, your keyboard and mouse on that host are paused and the window shows a Stop button. Calls need Regi running with Settings ▸ MCP turned on; until then Claude is told to ask you to open it, and the extension never launches Regi itself. Every call is listed in Regi's MCP Activity window.
